_comment: Home page chips and cards (owner-named chips, 2026-09-09). A chip with no cards shows an empty card row and leaves the window on whatever was playing. Card titles/blurbs are copied verbatim from CityAnatomyAustin/src/content/copy.ts; the owner writes all copy. src is the PREVIEW loaded into the map window; app (optional) is the full-screen web app, which opens in a NEW browser window from the small ↗ on the card (owner 2026-09-10: nobody uses the apps from the front page; the window keeps the animated Moontower and Austin1885 maps as previews). A chip may carry its own src (News Feed -> /news/): with no cards, picking the chip loads that page in the window. The chip with open: true is what the page opens on (owner 2026-09-10: the News Feed map loads first). A chip may carry from: a URL of apps/reports/reports.json shape; home.js turns each report into a card whose preview is its story map and whose app is its MapLibre map app at /apps/reports/<id>/.
